scope: Independent audit of core POST export for observed FAPEG 009/2024, followed by root-authorized publication/UI correction and isolated regression tests
acceptance_scope: Acquisition, persisted request identity, fenced checkpoints and local recovery. This review alone does not accept batch99 or certify canonical publication of FAPEG.
verified_properties: Typed request forbids additional headers, methods, content types and non-observed raw-body shape; source adapter binds endpoint, document ID, body and kind to the observed contest.
POST uses common public DNS, source URL, TLS, request-count, byte and stream-deadline guards; every POST redirect is rejected before following it.
Acquisition rejects a driver without POST support. HTTP/HTML failures do not invoke GET or browser fallback even when browser fallback is enabled.
Checkpoint wrapper rejects a stale lease before transport and compares the request candidate to the leased source/external-ID/detail identity.
POST request body participates in manifest and acquired-document identity, distinguishing versions at one endpoint. Changed request body creates a durable, deduplicated review hold.
Legacy GET manifests retain their former shape; existing signed-URL identity, historical observation matching and document-review regression tests pass.
Completed preserved official POST result recovers after a controlled queue-commit failure without reopening a driver or posting again. This focal recovery test does not kill a separate OS process.
Declarative recovery is still bounded candidate discovery for its existing supported source and has no network executor that can synthesize or replay POST requests.

integration_observations.classification: downstream UX integration limitation, not an acquisition blocker
integration_observations.evidence: Creation still stores/shows artifact.url_final as link_edital. For FAPEG this is https://selecao.go.gov.br/exportarEditalPdf while the observed export also requires body 177,0. The URL alone does not encode the selected document.
integration_observations.impact: Do not certify that this canonical URL alone is a working GET download of the original edital. Full request remains in the persisted run/proposal and original bytes remain preserved.
integration_observations.recommendation: When validating canonical FAPEG UX, use an authorized preserved-artifact download or the official detail page for navigation, preserving official endpoint and request provenance separately. Do not silently issue GET as a substitute.
integration_observations.resolution: New POST creations bind the observed official detail page as link_edital. Creation and update proposal views expose the existing authenticated artifact path and official page. UI invokes the existing authenticated PDF handler and offers an official-page link. Older creation proposals carrying the endpoint are marked stale and rejected until prepared/reviewed anew.
integration_observations.limit: No live GET probe or real canonical FAPEG publication was performed. Canonical create/update behavior uses explicitly synthetic controlled POST metadata and synthetic PDF; the authorization test serves the real preserved FAPEG PDF.

integration_observations.classification: defense-in-depth observation; no normal-flow exploit demonstrated
integration_observations.evidence: Publication revalidates candidate identity, endpoint URLs, preserved hash/bytes and extracted evidence, but does not call source.validate_document_request for the persisted POST descriptor.
integration_observations.impact: Independent checking of the stored method/body contract is weaker here than at acquisition. Demonstrating a bypass would require a path to alter trusted persisted run metadata; this audit did not find such a path and does not claim unsafe canonical fields can be published.
integration_observations.recommendation: Repeat source request-contract validation during publication without treating historical GET records as implicit POST.
integration_observations.resolution: Publication now invokes the source request validator when present or when POST metadata is supplied; rejects a source without the contract. Three negative tests use the real FAPEG adapter: altered body, missing request and wrong document ID are rejected before PDF processing.

authorized_followup_validation.untouched: Acquisition, canonical.py, models, migration, services, artifact router and storage were not changed.

backend.authorization: Existing artifact route: missing JWT 401, different owner 404, wrong artifact ID 404, exact owner 200 with byte-for-byte preserved FAPEG PDF and its SHA256.
backend.canonical_fixture: Controlled synthetic POST descriptor on the existing synthetic publication fixture; creates and updates through real publication/review/apply logic, idempotent repeat, official-page canonical link on create. This is not a claim of real FAPEG canonical minimum fields.

frontend.scope: Create/update review invokes authenticated PDF handler and official-page navigation; never opens the export endpoint as GET.
Existing review, approval, stale-proposal, rollback and document-pending component interactions.

api.note: Authenticated path is relative and must use the existing JWT API client, not an unauthenticated public hyperlink. Acquisition endpoint/body remain unmodified in the persisted run/proposal.

final_postgresql_validation.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_tenderproof_publication.py tests/test_tenderproof_canonical.py tests/test_tenderproof_publication_post.py tests/test_concurso_identity_migration.py tests/test_crawl_resilience.py tests/test_tenderproof_publication_postgres.py::test_postgres_additive_migration_from_canonical_tables --disable-warnings --tb=short
final_postgresql_validation.scope: PostgreSQL configured for publication, canonical and POST-publication fixtures; identity migration includes both SQLite and PostgreSQL parameterizations. Includes CAS concurrency, migration idempotence/rollback guards, legacy identity audit, crawl resilience and additive publication schema migration.
final_postgresql_validation.credentials: random password in child environment only; absent from commands, reports and logs

cleanup.independent_confirmation: docker container ls --all --filter name=tenderproof-batch99-post-final-pg-20260908 --format '{{.ID}} {{.Names}}' returned exit0 and empty output

resources.database_scope: pytest temporary isolated SQLite fixtures and generated schemas in the removed private PostgreSQL container

limitations: No production activation, live transport rerun or separate-process crash proof was performed by this audit. A final isolated PostgreSQL regression was subsequently run and cleaned up as recorded above.
Response limits were exercised with deterministic HTTP streams; socket/DNS wall-clock behavior remains the existing shared HTTP implementation.
First acquisition of historical GET metadata remains a baseline; POST metadata is additive and is not inferred for old GET documents.
Public URL redirects, alternate endpoints and document bodies outside the observed FAPEG contract remain explicitly unsupported.
